blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Dare I ask where and to which places you would like to go?
exercises.ru: Осмелюсь ли спросить: ___ и в какие места ехать изволите?
exercises.why: «The adverbs здесь (here), там (there), дома (at home) indicate location and answer the question где … сюда (here), туда (there), домой (home) indicate direction and answer the question куда.» — DLI, Lesson 19. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
